description: Register the local OLMoE GGUF routing target so later SAAQ runs can reference it. No packing or conversion happens here; existing GGUF artifacts are registered as-is.

combine_for_ai.notes: Existing GGUF can be benchmarked directly in combine-for-AI; magere recipe apply emits the handoff file.

corinth_canal.notes: Forward-declared only. The reference SAAQ implementation consumes this registration; the in-repo runner is magere run-saaq.

myelin_accelerator.notes: Forward-declared only. Kernel execution lives in myelin-accelerator; magere-brug records lineage, not kernels.
